measurement_protocol.target_definition: Full vocabulary JSD, natural log, all valid positions including last; no Qwen activation features
measurement_protocol.test_policy: Freeze data and methods before test; use train CV for tuning; report paired seeds separately from dataset folds

protocol.hypothesis: A log target may improve predictive distribution and domain CDF accuracy.
protocol.paired_design: Same texts, independent embeddings, train/validation/test and labeled indices.
protocol.primary: Validation macro-domain theta absolute error at epsilon=0.05, budget=192.
controls: Empirical per-domain fraction in the same random labeled set
limitations: These frozen research test sets have already been inspected.
Fixed labels do not test adaptive selection with log-space sigma.
The live fixed-label diagnostic is one seed and one dataset.
Seed SD is not uncertainty across independent datasets.
